{{Quote|The smaller craft are the combat vehicles. Stick with the five transports.|General Carlist Rieekan during the Rendezvous on Barkhesh|<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>}}
[[File:CombatVehicle00.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Combat vehicles assaulting Imperial installations on the Jade Moon.]]
'''Combat vehicles''' were small [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] [[Tank/Legends|tanks]]. They were armed with one [[Laser cannon/Legends|turret]] in the front and a double-barrel turret in the back, which could shoot over the front turret.

The [[Barkhesh Resistance]] employed three of these vehicles to escort five [[armed transport]]s being used to transport supplies to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] around [[0 ABY/Legends|6]] [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The combat vehicles were [[Rendezvous on Barkhesh|assisted]] by the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

Several of these tanks were used again by the Alliance during the [[Battle of the Jade Moon|assault]] on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] facility on the [[Jade Moon]]. One of them was under the direct control of General Carlist Rieekan during the strike.

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The combat vehicles appear in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]. Their in-game stats differ considerably between the two levels they appear in. On "Rendezvous on Barkhesh", the combat vehicles are extremely durable and can shrug off several proton torpedo hits, whereas on "the Jade Moon" they are much more fragile.
